name: box by Simular
description: Hosted cloud Linux desktop that any MCP client drives: an agent gets Chrome, a shell and a full Ubuntu desktop to browse, click, type, read the screen and run commands.

skills.name: Use a Cloud Desktop
skills.description: Give an agent a persistent Ubuntu desktop with Chrome to open sites, click, type and read the screen from any MCP client.

skills.name: Run Shell Commands
skills.description: Run commands and scripts in the box's persistent shell, with files and state kept while the desktop sleeps.

skills.name: Keep API Keys Hidden
skills.description: Store API keys as box secrets so commands use the real key while the AI only ever sees a stand-in value.

skills.name: Watch and Take Control
skills.description: Watch the agent's desktop live in the browser and take over the mouse and keyboard when a human is needed.
